title: Some lines legislate little stalls to slow rolls. Let language lick at lobes in flows of lava cooling on on burning tongues #smallpoems
summary: Some lines legislate little stalls to slow rolls. Let language lick at lobes in flows of lava cooling on on burning tongues #smallpoems
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Some lines
legislate
little stalls
to slow
  rolls.
Let language
lick at lobes
in flows of
   lava
cooling on
on burning
tongues
#smallpoems
